description:
Defines a Plan B temporal state store that holds the events displayed by a Floor Map.
Each event records the state of an entity, e.g. its position, from a point in time, so the Floor Map can show where every entity was at any moment.
The key and value encodings are fixed so that the Floor Map can always read the store efficiently.
How long an entity stays on the map after its last event, how long data is retained, the maximum size of the store and whether to condense data can all be configured.

Data is loaded into the store using the PlanBFilter pipeline element.
